name: Lyo.Web.WebRenderer.Models
tagline: Serializable HTML capture request and response. No Blazor and no browser.
description: Wire contract for an HTML capture. `WebRenderReq` carries the HTML and the PDF or image settings. `WebRenderRes` describes the file `IWebRenderGenerator` wrote. The Puppeteer implementation lives in `Lyo.Web.WebRenderer`.
features: **`WebRenderReq`.** HTML, format (`Pdf`, `Png`, `Jpeg`, `WebP`), paper (Letter, Legal, Tabloid, A3, A4, A5, or CSS), landscape, margin, scale, CSS page size, full page, viewport, JPEG/WebP quality, omit background, and output path.
**`WebRenderRes`.** Success, content type, file name, output path, byte length, and error.
**`IWebRenderGenerator`.** `GenerateAsync` writes the file named by the request. A host can call this without referencing PuppeteerSharp.

examples.title: Describe a Letter PDF

sections.title: What stays out of this package
sections.text: Razor component rendering stays on `IWebRendererService` in `Lyo.Web.WebRenderer` because that API takes `IComponent`. This package does not reference Blazor or PuppeteerSharp.
